mission: Make verified-upload redeploys the only path for collector variable changes; verify legitimately skipped API builds against their previous verified SHA

impacts.reason: Tooling/CI only. New scripts/collector_variables.py stages collector variables with --skip-deploys and redeploys the identical verified upload (marker + image digest), refusing GitHub rebuilds; a scan test refuses any other variable setter. Re-pinned scripts/snkr_storage_canary.py uses it with every original check plus head/upload code identity. Verifier resolves api_sha=merge from watch patterns and Railway's merge record: skipped-and-unchanged passes on the previous SHA; missing expected build or unexpected build fails. No services/, packages/ or deploy/ change: no collector, API or market-index rebuild; no schema, cron, budget, pacing, claim or writer change; no collector rollout requested.

routes: GitHub Actions staging-automerge delivery job; read-only staging verification GETs
dependencies: Collectors stay on verified 1b1b64d uploads (SNKR 18f66771 restored 09:10Z); continuity checks pinned to 1b1b64d
impact.deployment_impact: Vercel frontend build of unchanged app code only. No Railway service watch path touched, so API, market-index and collectors are expected SKIPPED. No collector upload, DDL, or provider variable/cron/budget/writer mutation.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR restores the previous workflows, verifier and tooling. No persistent state, collector image, schema or provider configuration changes, so no data restore is applicable.
recovery.trigger: Any Railway service builds for this merge, verifier accepts a skip while watched paths changed, collector variable tool changes a variable without verified-upload redeploy, or engineering-gate failure
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no database or provider state changes.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verification for this merge (api_expectation=skip on 1b1b64d), then the next natural turn of every collector on its verified 1b1b64d upload with unchanged schedules, flags and budgets
